scenarios.title: Search state bills
scenarios.purpose: Search state bills. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
successChecklist: Resolve Alabama and the 2026 Regular Session to returned UUIDs, search bill HB591 within them, report only matching candidates and show the results card.
Expected tool coverage: list_states, list_sessions, search_bills
Answer is supported by returned evidence; missing data and errors are disclosed.
scenarios.prompt:
Use the unchanged local Cicada Guide skills in .agents/skills. Read get-legislation/SKILL.md and the relevant task skill before answering. Use only the configured guide-public MCP tools for legislative facts. Do not use web search, shell HTTP requests, or outside knowledge as substitutes. Do not edit the skills, install anything, publish, or contact officials. Answer this user request: Find Alabama HB591 from the 2026 Regular Session.

Save your answer to answer.md and include it in your final response.
scenarios.finalMessagePreview:
Found **Alabama HB591, 2026 Regular Session**: “Rural Health Transformation Program supplemental appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.”

It appropriates up to **$203,404,327** for rural health initiatives and creates legislative oversight. Recorded status: **Passed**, dated April 13, 2026. The returned records do not establish enactment.

[Official enrolled bill](https://alison.legislature.state.al.us/files/pdf/SearchableInstruments/2026RS/HB591-enr.pdf)

Saved the answer, including sponsors, relevant votes, sources, and limitations, to [answer.md](C:/Users/forre/AppData/Local/Temp/plugin-eval-case-1-yUk8zd/workspace/answer.md).
